key_stat: 44,000 customers in 170+ countries | $2.8B Microsoft partnership | 33 petabytes of data | 30 data systems consolidating
summary: London Stock Exchange Group is a global financial infrastructure company. Post-Refinitiv acquisition ($27B, 2021). Microsoft 10-year partnership ($2.8B investment for 4% stake). Key products: Workspace (data terminal), FTSE Russell (indices), LCH (clearing), UnaVista (regulatory reporting), Acadia (derivatives). Massive technology transformation underway with Microsoft (Azure cloud, AI integration, Teams integration). Digital assets: limited but exploring via LCH and post-trade.

business_segments.name: Data & Analytics
business_segments.detail: ~60% of revenue. Workspace (terminal replacing Eikon). Financial Analytics. ESG. Real-time data. 44K customers, 170+ countries. Microsoft Fabric migration. MCP for agentic AI.

business_segments.name: FTSE Russell
business_segments.detail: ~$15T benchmarked to indices. ESG indices growing. S&P 500 competitor. Licensing revenue.

business_segments.name: Capital Markets
business_segments.detail: London Stock Exchange. Turquoise (MTF). Trading venues. Borsa Italiana sold to Euronext.

business_segments.name: Post-Trade
business_segments.detail: LCH (clearing — largest in rates). UnaVista (regulatory reporting). Acadia (derivatives margin). TORA (OEMS).

business_segments.name: Digital Markets Infrastructure
business_segments.detail: DMI for private funds. Connected, transparent access to private markets.

technology.ai: LSEG-Microsoft AI strategy: 'LSEG everywhere' agentic AI. MCP (Model Context Protocol) server for LSEG data in Microsoft Copilot Studio. AI agents built into trading/research workflows. Workspace AI copilot integration. NLP for news and analytics.
technology.cloud: Microsoft Azure (10-year, $2.8B minimum spend). Migrating data platform + infrastructure. Microsoft Fabric: consolidating 30 systems, 1,200 datasets, 33 petabytes. Spark on Fabric processing ~80,000 files daily. 50%+ month-on-month consumption growth.
technology.data: Massive: 33 petabytes across 30 systems, 1,200 datasets. Unifying on Microsoft Fabric. ESG data products. Financial Analytics. Fundamentals. Real-time market data. Reference data. Product development timelines cut from years to months.
technology.platforms: Workspace (terminal), REDI EMS (embedded in Workspace Sep 2025), FTSE Russell (indices), LCH (clearing), UnaVista (regulatory reporting), Acadia (derivatives), TORA (OEMS), Digital Markets Infrastructure (DMI) for private funds.
technology.spend: $2.8B minimum Azure commitment. £250-300M incremental 2023-2025. Innovation Forum Nov 2025 showcased engineering transformation.

operating_model: Post-Refinitiv integration. Microsoft partnership driving cloud transformation. Open platform strategy. API-first approach.
